title: Artsy Table
shortDescription: To pay homage to vintage modernism, Artsy Table celebrates triangular form and marquetry in wood with Indian Laurel, Rosewood and Teakwood.

pageData.longDescription: Every detail begins with precision. A full-scale template is created to achieve the perfect equilateral triangle and ensure every curve fits seamlessly. We carefully selected Indian Laurel, Jackwood, and Satinwood, allowing their natural colours, grain, and character to create a striking composition—without the need for artificial finishes. Every cut is guided by accuracy, setting the foundation for the craftsmanship that follows

title: Blooming
shortDescription: Sculpted with organic marquetry motifs and solid timber legs joined by a hand-burnished brass stretcher. Designed as an anchor statement piece for hospitality and dining salons.

pageData.longDescription:
Crafted from individual veneers hand-arranged by master artisans, the Blooming embodies quiet strength. A warm brass rail provides both structural counterweight and a rich visual horizon line.

The tactile marquetry surface features floral-inspired organic inlays rendered in varying tones of natural oak and walnut.

specs.materials: Natural Teak, Solid Oak Marquetry, Raw Brass

title: The Quiet Presence
shortDescription: Cast branch-like ironwork legs supporting tiered black slate slabs, complemented by an asymmetrical organic blackened bronze mirror frame.

pageData.longDescription:
An intersection of nature-inspired silhouette and architectural rigor. Hand-forged textured metalwork echoes organic branches, creating a striking conversation between darkness and reflection.

The matching mirror frame is cast in blackened bronze with a hand-hammered relief rim.

specs.materials: Forged Textured Iron, Black Slate, Bronze-tinted Glass

title: Pithalai
shortDescription: Hand-inlaid wood camouflage marquetry doors encasing warm interior storage, elevated on slender turned hardwood legs with an under-tier display shelf.

pageData.longDescription:
The Pithalai combines hundreds of individually cut pieces of aged teak, walnut, and oak to create a hypnotic undulating topography.

Interior fit-outs include custom stemware racks, mirrored bottle back-panels, and soft-close solid timber drawers.

specs.materials: Smoked Oak, Teak & Walnut Inlay, Polished Brass Fittings

title: Kall
shortDescription: Hand-painted floral and botanical fresco doors with carved chevron slats and an inverted pagoda floating mantle top, finished in midnight indigo lacquer.

pageData.longDescription:
A landmark statement credenza blending fine art painting with cabinetmaker joinery. Gilded botanical motifs emerge from deep Prussian blue oil glazes, crowned with a sculpted ebony floating ledge.

The geometric chevron panels open smoothly on concealed soft-close pivot hinges to reveal lined European oak shelving.

specs.materials: Indigo Lacquered Beech, Hand-painted Leaf Motifs, Ebony Top
